run_inference_attribute: run inference to compute attribution scores for input text using a loaded Ithaca model checkpoint
run_inference_restore: run inference to restore missing text spans using a loaded Ithaca model checkpoint
load_checkpoint: load a model checkpoint pickle to extract params, config, alphabet, and forward function for inference
run_main_cli: run the CLI entry point with --input or --input_file and --checkpoint_path to perform attribution and restoration
run_inference_with_file: run inference on text from a file using --input_file and save attribution and restoration results to JSON
